assumption_justifications.acs_risk_threshold: ASSUMPTION: Set to 0.25. On validation split, threshold 0.25 achieves 100.0% ACS recall with zero missed ischemic emergencies. In clinical decision support, false negatives for acute coronary events carry catastrophic risk, justifying escalation whenever P(ACS) >= 25%.
assumption_justifications.min_eig: ASSUMPTION: Set to 0.02 bits. Questions providing < 0.02 bits reduce uncertainty by < 1.5%, which does not justify asking additional intrusive questions to a distressed patient.
assumption_justifications.max_questions: ASSUMPTION: Set to 8. Limits patient interview burden in an emergency triage setting.
assumption_justifications.confidence_stop: ASSUMPTION: Set to 0.90. Allows early termination when diagnosis is definitive, provided P(ACS) is not elevated.
